_comment: #1784 step 3 inset families [D378] (Artem 2026-11-24): lamellas, roof steel cage, mesh, canopies = separate insets; F05 outer glazing = inset with own ends; cassette folds = texture. Synthetic: none. v007 [D384] (Artem 2026-11-24 ~19:55): + decor panels as relief insets, F05 piers (columns), F05 ground-floor glazing, window flashings, roof hatches; pergolas = the cage on the roof wells of body v007.
decisions: cage: columns = world-aligned square boxes (round tubes have no section axes); exact duplicate and touching/overlapping posts joined into one box; a column top just under a beam runs up to the beam axis; columns embedded 0.02 m into the roof below

cage: beams = diamond section (square turned 45 deg, faces at the tube radius) so no beam face is parallel to a column or a crossing beam; near-level beams (slope < 0.01) drawn level; ends inside a column footprint snapped to its axis, then every end runs on 0.37 r; collinear touching same-section segments joined; a stub inside a bigger parallel tube dropped; a thinner end-to-end beam laps 0.02 m into the thicker; parallel neighbours within 6 mm thinned 8 mm; an end face within 6 mm of a column face pushed 9 mm in
mesh: one quad per Revit mesh wall in its mid-plane (opacity sheet), normal away from the building centre (vertical) or up (roof mesh)
canopy: the glass sheet only (largest flat sheet of the family, hangers left out), closed box 6 quads; touching collinear sheets joined
lamella: closed box from the Revit panel box; the fold is texture [D378]

F05: glass over the Revit panel facets in front of the D06/D07 face line (sawtooth: 7 facets, 7 returns over the mullion gap, so every closure is a quad), clipped to the body mouth (contour_cut rects); top/bottom closures and end quads close the gap to the face [D378]

[D384] decor panels: each Revit 'Панель фасадная 2 Фигурная' = closed relief solid of 10 quads, rect shrunk by half the 0.02 m panel joint per side (Revit neighbours overlap up to 4 mm) (abutting Revit panels would share faces, xView): back quad at the Revit back plane, 4 rim quads to the front rim, 4 pyramid facets to the Revit apex truncated by a homothety about the apex to a 0.05 m top (every facet a planar trapezoid, real depth minus <= 0.025 m)

[D384] F05 piers (columns): the 0..7.5 m exterior-wall pieces in front of D06 (top >= 7.4 m, each piece <= 1.2 m in plan) grouped by station (gap < 0.3 m) -> one box per pier aligned to the body face D06 (Revit runs 2 deg off), front = Revit front, back 0.05 m behind the body face

[D384] F05 ground-floor glazing: one quad per bay between the piers, 0.02 m in front of the body face, from the base to the F05 mouth sill (the upper glazing closure); Revit glass stands 1.6-2.5 m behind the face line, inside the accepted body
[D384] flashings: one sloped quad per Revit flashing (its upper face, normal up); hatches: closed box from the Revit box
